title: Unused Vocabulary Slot Preservation (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `unused_token_hold` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Tests selective functional updating: an active concept token must move decisively toward its target (concept_move >= 0.85) while unqueried vocabulary slots remain undisturbed (unused_hold >= 0.85).
failure_mode: Global unconditioned updates, excessive weight decay, or leaky critic gradients bleed across shared parameters and corrupt unused token representations.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `unused_token_hold` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
